memoryMeter.cfgLead: What the collector keeps, and how often the widget refreshes its numbers.
memoryMeter.cfgUnavailable: The settings form is not available in this build.
memoryMeter.cfg_maxEventsPerSession_hint: Newest tool calls kept for one session.
memoryMeter.cfg_maxSessions_hint: The least recently created sessions are dropped first.
memoryMeter.cfg_maxStoreBytes_hint: Hard cap on the stored file; oldest sessions are dropped to stay under it.
memoryMeter.cfg_recentLimit_hint: How many recent accesses the endpoint sends to the widget.
memoryMeter.cfg_refreshSeconds_hint: How often the widget refetches the numbers.
memoryMeter.cfg_saveDebounceMs_hint: Writes are coalesced for this long before the file is flushed.
memoryMeter.cfg_trackInject_hint: Count the recalled-context snapshots dsh-memory-brain pushes into a turn.
memoryMeter.cfg_trackTools_hint: Count brain_recall, brain_remember and wiki_* calls.
memoryMeter.denied: Metrics unavailable: the endpoint answers only local and same-origin requests.
